name: Myra
source:
"You might not remember me yet, but I remember you."

The mysterious violet-haired girl who suddenly appears in front of Mark and disappears always like a ghost. She seems to know a lot about him, but always keeps a secret or two whenever Mark asks her something.

[spoiler]Mark and Myra used to be classmates in elementary school, and Myra had a crush on him; however, he rarely noticed her because of his crush on their class' most popular girl. The ribbon she wears on her hair is the same ribbon given to Mark after he was rejected by his crush. Because Myra was jealous of her, she decided to completely emulate her, but at the same time feels like she isn't worthy of loving Mark.

Myra's full name is Myra Kinsey, and she's the daughter of Leonard Kinsey, a wealthy company executive who contributed much to the town the story takes place in.[/spoiler]
